hindi: अमात्य राजा के व्यसन का इस प्रकार प्रतिकार करे।
english: In this way the minister should remedy the calamity of the king.

words.gloss: from fear of death or affliction
with the support of dear ones and well-wishers
at an interval of a month or two months

hindi: मृत्यु या बाधा के भय से पहले ही, राजा के प्रिय और हितैषी लोगों के सहयोग से, “राजा देश की पीड़ा को दूर करने वाला, शत्रुओं को दूर करने वाला, आयु के लिए हितकर अथवा पुत्र के लिए हितकर कर्म सम्पन्न कर रहा है” इस बहाने से एक या दो मास के अन्तर पर दर्शन की व्यवस्था करे।
english: Even beforehand, from fear of the king's death or affliction, with the support of [his] dear ones and well-wishers, [the minister] should arrange a viewing [of the king] at an interval of a month or two months, on the pretext: “The king is accomplishing an action that removes the country's affliction, that removes enemies, and that is conducive to long life or to sons.”
notes: Subject of sthāpayet (the minister) is carried over from unit 1. rājñaḥ may also be taken with darśanam ('a viewing of the king'). priya-hita: 'dear ones and well-wishers' (alternatively 'what is agreeable and beneficial'); upagraha = support (alternatively 'favour'). darśana = viewing, audience. karma: glossary 'action'; a ritual is meant in the pretext. āyuṣya/putrīya read as 'conducive to long life / to sons'. The closing iti only closes the quotation.

words.gloss: of the envoys of allies and enemies
words.gram: m. gen. pl. (dative sense), dvandva + tat-puruṣa

hindi: रूपरहित वेला में राजा का चिह्न प्रकृतियों को दिखाए, और मित्रों तथा शत्रुओं के दूतों को।
english: At a formless hour he should show the king's insignia to the constituent elements, and to the envoys of allies and enemies.
notes: Obscure: arūpa-velā rendered literally ('formless time'); it may mean an hour when features cannot be made out (dusk), but the text does not say. rāja-vyañjana: literally 'mark/sign of the king'; alternative 'a man in the guise of the king' (cf. X-vyañjana in the glossary). The genitives prakṛtīnām and dūtānām have dative sense with darśayet. Token 'darśayet,' keeps its comma in src.

words.gloss: having the minister at the head

hindi: और उनके साथ अमात्य को प्रमुख रखकर यथोचित वार्तालाप करे।
english: And with them, [he], having the minister at the head, should enter into fitting conversation.
notes: The subject is not expressed: 'he' (the king, or whoever is shown, cf. unit 3) is the likeliest, but the text does not say. mukha is taken as 'head, chief'; alternative 'having the minister as mouthpiece (spokesman)'. sambhāṣāṃ gacchet = enter into conversation.

words.gloss: having the doorkeeper and the antarvaṃśika at the head

hindi: और द्वारपाल तथा अन्तर्वंशिक को प्रमुख रखकर, जैसा कहा गया है वैसे राजा के प्रणिधि को चलाए रखे।
english: And, with the doorkeeper and the antarvaṃśika at the head, he should keep up the king's praṇidhi (routine) as stated.
notes: Obscure: antarvaṃśika (an officer of the inner apartments) is kept as a term; dauvārika = doorkeeper. rāja-praṇidhi: praṇidhi usually means 'agent, deputation'; here it is taken as the king's routine/conduct 'as stated' (the earlier passage on the king's conduct); the alternative is 'the king's agent(s)'. Not decided by the text.

hindi: अपकारियों के प्रति प्रकृतियों को प्रिय रोष अथवा कृपा दिखाए, उपकारियों के प्रति कृपा ही।
english: Toward wrongdoers he should show anger or favour, whichever is liked by the constituent elements; toward benefactors, favour only.
notes: heḍa (anger, hostility) is an uncommon word; rendered 'anger', alternative 'disfavour'. 'whichever' is supplied for the vā-clause; prakṛti-kānta could also qualify both nouns together ('anger or favour liked by the constituents'). Token 'eva-upakāriṣu' is an unsandhied join (eva upakāriṣu).

words.gloss: situated in a fort or on the frontier

hindi: आप्त पुरुषों के अधीन, दुर्ग में अथवा सीमा पर स्थित कोश और दण्ड को एक स्थान पर स्थित करवाए; और कुल्यों, कुमारों तथा मुख्यों को अन्य बहाने से।
english: He should have the treasury and the army, placed under trusted men and situated in a fort or on the frontier, stationed together; and [he should have] the kinsmen, princes and chiefs [so placed] on another pretext.
notes: The second clause has no verb: the kinsmen, princes and chiefs are taken as a second object of kārayet (placed likewise). kulya: 'kinsman, member of the family' (medium). Token 'ca-anya.apadeśena' is an unsandhied join. daṇḍa = army (glossary).

words.gloss: staying in a fort or forest

hindi: और जो मुख्य पक्ष वाला हो और दुर्ग या वन में स्थित हो, यदि वह वैगुण्य को प्राप्त हो, तो उसे अपनी ओर मिलवाए।
english: And whichever chief, having a following and staying in a fort or a forest, may fall into disaffection, him he should have won over.
notes: vaiguṇya = lack of good qualities, hence 'disaffection' here (medium). upa-grah (causative) = have him taken in/won over; cf. unit 13 and 14. 'vā' links 'fort or forest'.

hindi: अथवा बहुत कष्टों वाली यात्रा पर भेजे, या मित्र के कुल के पास।
english: Or he should send [him] on an expedition full of many hardships, or [to] the family of an ally.
notes: The object of preṣayet (the chief of unit 8) is not stated; 'him' supplied in brackets. mitra-kulam is taken as a goal ('to the family of an ally'); the e-text has it in the accusative without a postposition. ābādha = hardship, trouble.

words.gloss: festival, wedding, tying of elephants, horses for sale, gift of land (members of the compound)

hindi: और जिस सामन्त से बाधा देखे, उसे उत्सव, विवाह, हाथियों के बाँधने, घोड़ों की बिक्री और भूमि के दान के बहाने रुकवाए, अथवा अपने मित्र के द्वारा।
english: And the neighbour from whom he sees trouble, him he should have restrained on the pretext of a festival, a wedding, the tying of elephants, the sale of horses or a gift of land, or through his own ally.
notes: The token ending '.-' is a compound continued in the next token: utsava-vivāha-hasti-bandhana-aśva-paṇya-bhūmi-pradāna-apadeśena. Division of the members (hasti-bandhana 'tying/capture of elephants', aśva-paṇya 'sale of horses', bhūmi-pradāna 'gift of land') is the likeliest reading. sāmanta = neighbour (neighbouring ruler). avagrah (caus.) = have restrained, held back.

hindi: तब निर्दोष सन्धि करवाए।
english: Then he should have an unobjectionable treaty made.
notes: adūṣya is taken as an adjective of sandhi ('not to be faulted'). Alternative: 'a treaty with the not-treasonable (adūṣya)', cf. dūṣya in the glossary. The e-text has sandhim as accusative masculine, which fits both.

hindi: अथवा आटविकों और शत्रुओं से वैर ग्रहण करवाए।
english: Or he should make [him] take up enmity with forest chiefs and enemies.
notes: The person made to take up enmity is not named; 'him' is supplied in brackets. āṭavika-amitra is read as a dvandva; alternative 'with enemies of forest chiefs'.

words.gloss: with one part of the land

hindi: अथवा उसके कुल के व्यक्ति को या निकाले गए राजकुमार को भूमि के एक भाग द्वारा अपनी ओर मिलवाए।
english: Or he should have a member of his family, or a prince in disfavour, won over with one part of the land.

text_flags.why: possible typo: anusvāra for m before y in the compound; the sandhi form of bhūmi + eka is bhūmy-eka

notes: tat-kulīna and aparuddha as in the glossary; the first is 'of the same family as him' (the enemy or the chief of the previous units; not stated). bhūmi = land (territory).

words.gloss: the support of kinsmen, princes and chiefs

hindi: अथवा कुल्यों, कुमारों और मुख्यों का समर्थन प्राप्त करके कुमार को अभिषिक्त ही दिखाए।
english: Or, having secured the support of the kinsmen, princes and chiefs, he should show the prince as consecrated indeed.
notes: upagraha = support (alternative: 'winning over'). abhiṣiktam eva: 'as consecrated indeed', i.e. as one already consecrated; 'eva' is emphatic and not rendered further.

hindi: अथवा दाण्डकर्मिक के समान राज्य के कण्टकों को उखाड़कर राज्य करवाए।
english: Or, like a dāṇḍakarmika (one engaged in punitive action), having uprooted the thorns of the kingdom, he should have the kingdom ruled.
notes: dāṇḍakarmika is a technical term kept as printed; 'one engaged in punitive action' is the literal sense (dāṇḍa-karman). Object/subject of rājyaṃ kārayet not stated (rule by the king/prince under the minister). 'thorns' = a figure for enemies of the state.

words.gloss: of the neighbours and the rest

hindi: अथवा यदि कोई मुख्य, सामन्त आदि में से कोई एक, क्रोध करे, तो उसे “आओ, मैं तुम्हें राजा बनाऊँगा” ऐसा कहकर बुलाकर मरवा दे।
english: Or if some chief, one of the neighbours and the rest, should resort to anger, he should call him — “Come, I shall make you king” — and have him killed.
notes: kopa: rendered 'anger'; the alternative is 'revolt' (cf. 8.2). sāmanta-ādīnām anyatamaḥ: 'one among the neighbours and others'. 'tvā' is the enclitic accusative of 'you' (tvām). The closing iti belongs to the call: it is not rendered in English except by the quotation marks.

hindi: अथवा आपत्ति के प्रतिकार से निपटाए।
english: Or he should deal with [it] by the remedy for adversity.
notes: The object of sādhayet is not stated; 'it' is supplied. āpat-pratīkāra: the 'remedies for adversity' set out in the earlier chapters (cf. unit 22 yathā-uktam āpat-pratīkāram).

hindi: अथवा युवराज पर क्रमशः राज्य का भार रखकर राजा के व्यसन को घोषित करे।
english: Or, having gradually placed the burden of the kingdom on the heir-apparent, he should announce the calamity of the king.

words.gloss: in the guise of an enemy

hindi: शत्रु की भूमि में राजा का व्यसन होने पर, शत्रु का रूप धारण किए हुए मित्र द्वारा शत्रु के साथ सन्धि स्थापित करवाकर लौट जाए।
english: When the king's calamity occurs in an enemy's land, having had a treaty with the enemy established by an ally in the guise of an enemy, he should withdraw.
notes: para-bhūmau: 'in another's land', taken as the enemy's land. The locative absolute rāja-vyasane is read as 'when the calamity of the king occurs'. 'Having had ... established' for avasthāpya (the ally does it; the minister has it done). Tokens 'mitreṇa-amitra.vyañjanena' and 'avasthāpya-apagacchet' are unsandhied joins. sandhim = treaty (glossary).

words.gloss: of the neighbours and the rest

hindi: अथवा सामन्त आदि में से किसी एक को इसके दुर्ग में स्थापित करके लौट जाए।
english: Or, having placed one of the neighbours and the rest in his fort, he should withdraw.
notes: asya ('his') is not clearly resolved: it is read as the fort of the enemy of the previous unit; the alternative is the king's own fort. Tokens 'vā-asya' and 'sthāpayitvā-apagacchet' are unsandhied joins.

hindi: अथवा कुमार का अभिषेक करके प्रतिव्यूह रचे।
english: Or, having consecrated the prince, he should draw up a counter-array.
notes: prati-vyūh: to draw up one's forces against (an array); the object (the enemy) is not stated. Literal 'counter-array' kept.

hindi: अथवा शत्रु द्वारा आक्रान्त होने पर, जैसा कहा गया है वैसे आपत्ति का प्रतिकार करे।
english: Or, when attacked by an enemy, he should apply the remedy for adversity as stated.
notes: para = enemy (literally 'another'). Tokens 'pareṇa-abhiyukto' is an unsandhied join.

hindi: “इस प्रकार अमात्य एकैश्वर्य करवाए,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “In this way the minister should bring about sole sovereignty,” says Kautilya.
notes: eka-aiśvarya: 'sole sovereignty' (opposed to dual rule); kārayet has no stated beneficiary (the king or the prince). Formula 'iti X' = '..., says X' (glossary).

hindi: “ऐसा नहीं,” ऐसा भारद्वाज कहते हैं।
english: “Not so,” says Bharadvaja.
notes: Token '"na-evam"' is an unsandhied join (na evam). Formula follows the glossary for 'na iti X'.

words.gram: m. loc. sg., pres. part. ātm. pra-√mṛ

hindi: “राजा के मरते समय अमात्य कुल्यों, कुमारों और मुख्यों को आपस में, अथवा मुख्यों पर, आक्रमण करवाए।
english: “Or, when the king is dying, the minister should make the kinsmen, princes and chiefs attack one another, or [attack] the chiefs.
notes: The opening quotation mark in src starts Bharadvaja's view; no closing mark or closing iti is printed in the following units (the view seems to run on through unit 31, but this is not marked). 'pramriyamāṇe' is the form as printed (pra-√mṛ pres. part. ātm. loc.). mukhyeṣu vā: 'or against the chiefs' (literally 'among/in the chiefs'); medium. Glossary: vikramayet = should make attack.

words.gloss: by an uprising of the constituent elements

hindi: आक्रमण करने वाले को प्रकृतियों के विद्रोह द्वारा मरवा दे।
english: He should have the one who has attacked killed by an uprising of the constituent elements.
notes: vikrānta literally 'one who has stepped forth / shown prowess'; rendered 'attacked' to match vikramayet in unit 25. Alternative: 'the valiant one'.

hindi: अथवा कुल्यों, कुमारों और मुख्यों को गुप्त दण्ड से निपटाकर स्वयं राज्य ग्रहण करे।
english: Or, having dealt with the kinsmen, princes and chiefs by secret punishment, he should take the kingdom himself.

hindi: क्योंकि राज्य के कारण पिता पुत्रों से और पुत्र पिता से द्रोह करते हैं; फिर अमात्य-प्रकृति का तो कहना ही क्या, जो राज्य पर एकमात्र नियन्त्रण रखती है।
english: For on account of the kingdom a father plots against [his] sons and sons against [their] father; how much more then the minister element, which indeed has sole control of the kingdom?

text_flags.why: possible typo: spurious extra d; kāraṇāt + hi gives kāraṇād dhi, here printed 'kāraṇādd hi'

notes: kim aṅga punar is an idiom, 'how much more (then)'. pragraha = control, hold (the reins); alternative 'sole holder of the kingdom'. amātya-prakṛti = the constituent element that is the minister.

hindi: अपने आप उपस्थित हुए उसकी अवहेलना न करे।
english: That, come of itself, he should not disregard.
notes: 'tat' (that) is the kingdom just mentioned (rājyam) in context; not named in the unit. Token 'na-avamanyeta' is an unsandhied join.

words.gram: f. nom. sg., pass. pres. part. √tyaj

hindi: “स्वयं आरूढ़ हुई स्त्री छोड़ी जाने पर शाप देती है,” ऐसी लोक-कहावत है।
english: “A woman who has come up of her own accord curses when abandoned,” is the popular saying.
notes: ārūḍhā: literally 'mounted, ascended'; here a woman who has come up to a man of her own accord (the figure for a kingdom that comes by itself). The word 'iti' is not rendered as 'thus'. Token 'tyajyamānā-abhiśapati' is an unsandhied join.

words.gram: m. gen. sg., desid. pres. part. √kṛ

hindi: और जिस मनुष्य के पास, जो समय की आकांक्षा करता है, समय एक बार आता है, कर्म करने की इच्छा रखने वाले उसके लिए वह समय फिर दुर्लभ होता है।
english: And the time comes once to the man who desires the time; that time is hard to get again for him who wishes to do the action.
notes: Anuṣṭubh verse. kāla-kāṅkṣin: 'desiring the (right) time'; 'time' is kept literal (alternative 'opportunity'). karma = action (glossary).

words.gloss: causing an uprising of the constituent elements

hindi: “यह प्रकृतियों के विद्रोह का कारण, अत्यन्त अधार्मिक और अनिश्चित है,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “This causes an uprising of the constituent elements, is most unrighteous and uncertain,” says Kautilya.
notes: anaikāntika = not certain, not conclusive (an uncertain result); rendered 'uncertain'. adharmiṣṭha: superlative of adharmin ('most unrighteous'). Token 'ca-etad' is an unsandhied join. Formula 'iti X' per glossary.

hindi: आत्मसम्पन्न राजपुत्र को राज्य में स्थापित करे।
english: He should install in the kingdom a king's son endowed with [excellence of] self.
notes: ātma-sampanna: 'endowed with (excellence of) self' per the glossary rule for ātman in such compounds (never 'soul'); the sense is a prince of good qualities, but the text does not say more.

words.gloss: in the absence of one endowed

hindi: सम्पन्न के अभाव में व्यसनरहित कुमार को, अथवा राजकन्या को, अथवा गर्भवती रानी को आगे करके और महामात्रों को एकत्र करके कहे: “यह तुम्हारी धरोहर है; इसके पिता को, इसके सत्त्व और कुल को, और अपने आपको देखो; यह केवल ध्वज है, आप ही स्वामी हैं; अथवा क्या किया जाए?”
english: In the absence of one so endowed, having put forward a prince free from vice, or a king's daughter, or a pregnant queen, and having assembled the high officials, he should say: “This is a deposit for you; look to his father, [his] spirit and high birth, and your own; this one is only a banner, you, sirs, alone are the masters; or how is it to be done?”
notes: sampanna-abhāve: 'in the absence of (a prince) so endowed', picking up ātma-sampanna of unit 33. avyasanin: 'free from vice' (glossary 8.3 sense). nikṣepa = deposit, trust; 'vaḥ' is 'to you' (alternative 'your deposit'). 'pitaram asya avekṣadhvam sattva-abhijanam ātmanaś ca': 'ātmanaḥ' is read as 'your own', parallel to his father and his spirit and high birth; the sentence is loosely built and another reading ('and consider yourselves') is possible. sattva = spirit (alternatives: strength, character). svāmin here = 'masters' (not the prakṛti 'king'). The line is one long printed sentence; tokens 'pitaram asya-avekṣadhvaṃ' contains an unsandhied join. The 'devī' is the queen.

words.gram: m. acc. sg., pres. part. ātm. √brū

hindi: इस प्रकार बोलने वाले से गुप्त पुरुष कहें: “आप जिसके अग्रणी हैं, ऐसे इस राजा से अन्य कौन चारों वर्णों की रक्षा करने के योग्य है?”
english: To him who speaks thus the secret agents should say: “Who other than this king, with you at his head, is fit to protect the four varṇas?”
notes: The glossary gives yoga-puruṣa = secret agent. bhavat-puroga: 'having you as leader/at the head' (agreeing with rājñaḥ). cāturvarṇya = the four varṇas (the fourfold order). Token "'nyo" = anyaḥ. The unit has no second line; the printed split into two sentences is as in the input.

words.gloss: of the envoys of allies and enemies
words.gram: m. gen. pl. (dative sense), dvandva + tat-puruṣa

hindi: “वैसा ही हो,” कहकर अमात्य कुमार को, अथवा राजकन्या को, अथवा गर्भवती रानी को अधिकृत करे, और बन्धुओं तथा सम्बन्धियों को, मित्रों और शत्रुओं के दूतों को दिखाए।
english: Saying “So be it,” the minister should put the prince, or the king's daughter, or the pregnant queen in authority, and should show [him or her] to kinsmen and relatives and to the envoys of allies and enemies.
notes: 'saying' is supplied for the quoted tathā + iti (iti introduces the minister's reply). The object shown (darśayet) is not repeated. adhi-√kṛ: put in authority (alternative 'appoint'). Genitives of the recipients have dative sense. Token 'vā-adhikurvīta' is an unsandhied join.

words.gloss: a distinction in rations and wages
of the men who live by arms

hindi: अमात्यों और आयुधीयों के भोजन और वेतन में विशेषता करवाए; “और यह बड़ा होकर अधिक करेगा,” ऐसा कहे।
english: He should have a distinction made in rations and wages for the ministers and the men who live by arms; “And this one, when grown up, will do more,” he should say.
notes: bhakta-vetana-viśeṣa: literally 'a distinction/special feature in food and pay', probably an increase; the text does not say. āyudhīya = one who lives by weapons (soldier). 'bhūyas' = more; the object of kariṣyati is not stated. The token 'ca-ayaṃ' is an unsandhied join.

words.gloss: the chiefs of the forts and the country
the party of allies and enemies

hindi: इसी प्रकार दुर्ग और राष्ट्र के मुख्यों से सम्भाषण करे, और यथायोग्य मित्र तथा शत्रु के पक्ष से।
english: In the same way he should address the chiefs of the fort and the country, and, as is fitting, the party of allies and enemies.

hindi: और कुमार के अनुशासन-कर्म में प्रयत्न करे।
english: And he should strive in the disciplining of the prince.
notes: vinaya-karman: the work of discipline/training of the prince.

hindi: अथवा कन्या में समान जाति वाले से सन्तान उत्पन्न कराके अभिषेक करे।
english: Or, having had offspring produced on the daughter from one of equal birth, he should consecrate [it].
notes: kanyā is the king's daughter of unit 34. The object of abhiṣiñcet (the offspring) is not repeated. jātīya = of the (same) birth/class. Token 'vā-abhiṣiñcet' is an unsandhied join.

words.gloss: from fear of agitation of mind

hindi: माता के चित्त के क्षोभ के भय से अल्प सत्त्व वाले कुल्य को और लक्षणयुक्त छात्र को समीप रखे।
english: From fear of agitation of the mother's mind, he should place near [her] a kinsman of little spirit and a pupil bearing auspicious marks.
notes: Obscure: the whole unit is uncertain. upa-ni-√dhā is rendered literally 'place near'; where (near whom) is not stated, 'her' is a guess (the mother). chātra could be 'pupil' or a kind of person; lakṣaṇya is taken as 'bearing (auspicious) marks'. It is also possible that the two accusatives describe one person, or that the ca joins kulyam alpa-sattvam with chātram lakṣaṇyam. Not decided.

hindi: और ऋतुकाल में उसकी रक्षा करे।
english: And in the [fertile] season he should guard her.
notes: enām refers to the kanyā of units 34/40 (the king's daughter). ṛtu = season, here probably the woman's fertile period; rendered literally with a bracket. Token 'ca-enāṃ' is an unsandhied join.

hindi: और अपने लिए कोई उत्कृष्ट उपभोग न करवाए।
english: And he should not have any superior enjoyment provided for himself.
notes: Token 'ca-ātma.arthaṃ' is an unsandhied join.

words.gloss: vehicles, mounts, ornaments, clothes, women, houses and parivāpa

hindi: परन्तु राजा के लिए यान, वाहन, आभरण, वस्त्र, स्त्रियाँ, घर और परिवाप करवाए।
english: But for the king's sake he should have vehicles, mounts, ornaments, clothes, women, houses and parivāpa provided.
notes: parivāpa is obscure and kept as a Sanskrit word (literally something like 'strewing around / enclosure'; perhaps 'accessories, furnishings' but not certain). The last member could also go with veśma ('houses and their parivāpa').

words.gloss: for the sake of the mind

words.gram: m. acc. sg., pres. part. √tuṣ with a-

hindi: यौवन में स्थित से चित्त के कारण विश्राम माँगे; असन्तुष्ट को छोड़ दे और सन्तुष्ट का पालन करे।
english: And he should ask the one who is in youth for rest, for the sake of the mind. He should abandon the one who is not satisfied, and look after the one who is satisfied.
notes: Obscure sense: who is 'in youth' and whose 'mind' (citta) is meant are not stated; likely the prince now grown (he should ask him for rest/retirement), but the text does not say. citta-kāraṇāt = 'for the sake of / on account of the mind'. The second line (the dissatisfied and the satisfied) is also left without stated persons. Token 'ca-anupālayet' is an unsandhied join. Anuṣṭubh verse.

words.gloss: for the protection of his sons

hindi: पुत्रों की रक्षा के लिए छिपे हुए बहुमूल्य पदार्थ और परिग्रह सौंपकर, अप्रिय हो जाने पर वह वन अथवा दीर्घ सत्र का सेवन करे।
english: Having made over, for the protection of [his] sons, [his] hidden valuables and possessions, and having fallen into disfavour, he should resort to a forest or a long sacrificial session.
notes: nivedya: to whom the goods are made over is not stated. parigraha = possessions (alternatively 'dependants, household'). sattra is rendered 'sacrificial session' (alternative sense in other books: 'hiding place'). ārucyatāṃ: the printed 'seveta-ārucyatāṃ' is the sandhi form of seveta + arucyatām (a-rucyatā, disfavour); not a typo.

words.gloss: one who has resorted to those dear to him

hindi: अथवा मुख्यों द्वारा रोके गए राजा को, उसके प्रियजनों का आश्रय लेने वाला अर्थशास्त्र का ज्ञाता इतिहास और पुराण से बोध कराए।
english: Or the king restrained by the chiefs — one who has resorted to those dear to him, a knower of the artha-śāstra, should instruct [him] by itihāsa and purāṇa.
notes: Anuṣṭubh verse. avagṛhīta = held back, restrained (cf. avagrāhayet in unit 10). tat-priya: 'those dear to him' (the king). The words itihāsa and purāṇa are kept as terms ('history/legend and ancient lore' only in notes).

words.gloss: having the form of one in the guise of a holy man

hindi: अथवा सिद्ध के वेश का रूप धारण करने वाला, योग का आश्रय लेकर राजा को प्राप्त करे; प्राप्त करके दूष्यों के विषय में दाण्डकर्मिक का आचरण करे।
english: Or, one with the form of a holy man's guise, having resorted to a secret contrivance, should obtain [access to] the king; having obtained [it], he should practise the dāṇḍakarmika [action] toward the treasonable.
notes: yoga here = secret contrivance (as in Book 12); dūṣya = the treasonable (glossary). labheta pārthivam: literally 'should obtain the king', rendered 'obtain access to'. dāṇḍakarmika is used as a noun for the punitive procedure (cf. unit 15); the exact sense is uncertain. Subject is the artha-śāstra-vit of unit 47.
